result: I reviewed the actual diff (not the self-report) and rejected PR #602. The audit report content itself is solid — real, cross-verified findings on OWNER_ENGINE phases 4/5/8/9. But the `PROGRESS.md` edit is corrupted: this task's own progress notes were written into the body of a completely unrelated prior task's section (`task-20260727-101145-reporting-api-gateway`), permanently deleting that task's ~275 lines of real completed-work documentation plus the full sections of three other unrelated tasks nested below it, while this task's own newly-added header at the top is left empty. That's a real audit-trail-destroying defect in a file this repo explicitly treats as append-only (evidenced by the "keep-both, append-only" merge commits right before this PR in the log). Verdict recorded in `review-verdict.json` as `reject`, tier1, with the specifics and a suggested fix (restore the deleted sections, re-append this task's notes under its own header).
